title: Calling `setUiState` directly does not trigger `onStateChange` when defined.
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

When calling `setUiState` directly, if `onStateChange` is defined, it does not get called. The state gets properly updated, but the handler is not triggered, even though a state change occurred.

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/s/bold-sunset-k7giog?file=/src/app.js

* Type something or filter using the facets to set the state to something other than the default value.
* Click the added button which will reset the state using `setUiState` manually.
* Note that the `onStateChange` function does not get called (nothing in the console).

## 💭 Expected behavior

When calling `setUiState` directly (e.g. via a button click or change), the `onStateChange` handler should get called if it's defined.

## Environment

* OS Mac Monterey 12.5.1
* Browser: Chrome
* Version: 4.44

## Known Workaround

Using a middleware `.onStateChange` will get called.
